verdict.rationale: three.js is a browser 3D library. Its current builds ship both a WebGL renderer and a WebGPU renderer (WebGPURenderer), and its TSL node materials run on both backends, which gives a credible WebGPU migration path. Community reports confirm it works well as a WebGL abstraction across devices. Missing for 10: no evidence on payload or bundle size, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of WebGPU production readiness.
